Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Bravo Fighter]]: the poster of the 1999 film ''Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace''.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Star_Wars_Phantom_Menace_poster.jpg Star Wars Phantom Menace poster.jpg], Wikipedia, shown on the Wikipedia article [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_I_%E2%80%93_The_Phantom_Menace Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace]. Preserved copy of the article: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015121631/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_I_%E2%80%93_The_Phantom_Menace Internet Archive], 15 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (300 pixels tall) of the poster of the 1999 film ''Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace'', the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of the work exists.
